title: Internal-external attention switching SEEG epochs, DMN and DAN channels, 25 epilepsy patients (Hammer et al. 2024)
description: Stereo-EEG epochs from 25 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing presurgical monitoring, recorded while they alternated between an external-attention visual search task and an internal-attention autobiographical question task. Epochs span -4 to +4 s around each task switch (external-to-internal or internal-to-external). They are limited to bipolar channels assigned to the default mode network and dorsal attention network by the Yeo-7 atlas. This is a BIDS repackaging of the authors' preprocessed release. The physical unit of the signal is not stated by the authors; channels are labelled µV as a curator assumption.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with DIXI Medical depth electrodes and Quantum/NeuroWorks amplifiers at 2048 Hz, with reference and ground in white matter. The authors downsampled to 512 Hz, removed channels in the seizure-onset or irritative zone, heterotopic cortex, or broken channels, and applied bipolar referencing, a 0.1 Hz high-pass filter and a 50 Hz notch filter with harmonics. Epochs of -4 to +4 s were cut around task switches. Contacts were localised on post-implantation CT coregistered to MRI and normalised to MNI space with SPM12.
